archive.catalogue_description: ​​​​​ Empty Walls is an original custom zombies map set NW of the Tiergarten in Berlin. This map provides several ways to navigate these “Empty Walls” by changing up the oldschool gameplay loop with its dynamic visuals and environmental storytelling . Be sure to stay alert! This is an ACTIVE bombing zone! INCLUDES: Unique Level-wide​​​ Bombing Event “Dud” Bombs(Shootable Traps) SP + MP WAW Weapons Sharable Mystery Box Pack-a-Punch BO1 Perks FOV Slider On Pause Menu Russian & German Zombies NO BSP LEAKS PLAYERS MUST KNOW: Requires T4M Map must be launched with textures set to “High” or lower PHD only protects you from “dud” bombs NOT falling bombs You can only hide under intact ceilings – Awnings, catwalks, rafter roofs do NOT count Known Bugs: Mule Kick takes a random weapon when downed, Russian zombies sometimes appear invisible and their ​​​​​ legs spawn in the player’s head when killed by electric traps ​​​​​​ NEW UPDATE THIS MAP WILL BE RECEIVING UPDATES Last Updated: 1/7/2023 12:50pm CST Changelog Under Credits CREDITS (A-Z) BazookaJimmy cpt_johnson1 Gingerboi MidgetBlaster NGcaudle RadimaX Tom_BMX Vertasea YaF3li CHANGELOG Fixed zombies getting stuck in 2 barriers (if anyone notices more lmk here) Buffed “dud” bombs (3x what it was before) Added more MP guns and fixed existing MP gun’s PAP fx (THANK YOU Gingerboi) Balanced MP guns and buffed Bazooka by a lot (basically a wonder-weapon now) Added 2nd wall buys for Thompson, Bar, FG42, STG 44, MP40 Removed wall buy for Ty
